between_read_deltas.delta_note: the earlier read is 7.3 hours earlier on the same report week; blank is not 'available'

injury_report.no_designation_note: on this report week only the Thursday fixture carries game designations; a Sunday club's blank cell is blank, not 'available'. A feature built on designations has one game of coverage this week.

gaps.why_it_matters: the brief asks for depth modelled from playing time, not jersey order. No snap-count series exists in this repository and this session could not read an official one.
gaps.what_would_fill_it: an official NFL snap-count publication, captured per week with a timestamp
gaps.then_what: re-fit the depth feature on snaps and report the difference against the chart-based version, with uncertainty

gaps.why_it_matters: a backup replacing a starter cannot be confirmed from a chart; the inactive list is the evidence
gaps.what_would_fill_it: the official inactive list per game, captured at kickoff
gaps.then_what: join it to the chart to convert 'suspected replacement' into 'confirmed replacement'

gaps.missing: a depth-order source verified for all 32 clubs
gaps.why_it_matters: the brief's own precondition for building the backup-deficiency feature
gaps.what_would_fill_it: a structured Houston chart (currently image-only), or an official snap-count source covering all clubs
gaps.then_what: the feature may be built; until then it must not be

gaps.why_it_matters: one capture per club cannot show turnover, and the brief calls roster turnover a first-class event
gaps.what_would_fill_it: daily captures of the 32 club charts with retained hashes
gaps.then_what: diff consecutive captures and version each row against the last official roster event

gate.name: backup-deficiency feature
gate.why: G3 is unmet: one club's chart is image-only, so no depth-order source is verified for all 32 clubs. No deficiency feature is built, and no fixed points penalty is substituted for one.
